problem.title: DiLO KITTI Odom seq 05 full (2761 frames): held-out check of the paper pipeline
problem.question: Does the DiLO paper pipeline, with the values chosen on seq 07 (00 held out), stay near the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry error (official RTE) on seq 05?

variants.label: DiLO paper pipeline, spread planar key points, degenerate translation directions kept at the prediction
variants.intent: As paper_odometry_spread_keypoints, plus solution remapping (not in the paper): translation directions whose eigenvalue in the translation block of the normal equations is below 0.03 of the largest keep the prediction. Chosen on KITTI 01 (open highway, 8.7 -> 1.5 %; 0.02-0.05 all work); 00 and 07 are unchanged.

variants.label: DiLO paper pipeline + spread planar key points + slope-aware vertical fill + 0.18 deg correction
variants.intent: Planarity > 0.98 and at most one key point per 8 x 8 px cell per list (the ground list clustered ahead of the car, the side lists on vegetation, so roll was barely constrained), a vertical fill that no longer puts the far ground under the road (fill_slope 0.1), and the 0.18 deg correction that zeroes the pitch bias once the fill is fixed. Chosen on 07 windows, 00 windows held out (see papers/dilo/README.md).
